problem: A live deployment can be correctly proven in chat while the durable repository learning, skill projection, development ledger and human documentation lag behind, leaving future agents without canonical closure evidence.
root_cause: Terminal production proof and post-proof knowledge writeback were treated as separable follow-up work instead of one delivery obligation.
fix: Require same-lineage post-LIVE writeback across skill, Brain learning, append-only development ledger and human change documentation, bound to the production identity and browser/function evidence actually used.
prevention: Do not finish a live delivery with chat-only evidence.
Persist skill, Brain learning, ledger and human documentation after production proof.
Reuse existing production proof only for explicitly non-production descendants allowed by the safe-supersession contract.
Require fresh production proof when runtime-affecting paths advance.
evidence: Production deploy commit 06c650b72ae6a9386ceed4d20a32d8fd84ad7329 was observed ready in Netlify production.
Canonical production readback lineage proved affected routes plus pricing interactions and English route before the live claim.
This closure writes the rule into skill, Brain learning, ledger and human documentation.
